newsitem.title: USA: Neuromedical Systems says CEO resigns.
newsitem.headline: Neuromedical Systems says CEO resigns.

text.p: Neuromedical Systems Inc said on Monday that its president and chief executive officer, Mark Rutenberg, had resigned from the company.
Rutenberg will continue to serve as non-executive chairman of the board until a new chairman and chief executive can be found, the healthcare technology company said in a statement.
In the meantime, Uzi Ish-Hurwitz, executive vice president, and John Henneman III, vice president of corporate development, will jointly serve as chief executive, Neuromedical said.

"As the company now moves toward large-scale commercialization of Papnet testing, I would like to turn my attention to assisting the company in further developing its products and turn the day-to-day management of the growing public company over to a healthcare management expert," Rutenberg said.
The Papnet testing system is used in cervical screening to pinpoint potentially abnormal cells.
